item.title: G-7 to Discuss Joint Emergency Oil Reserves Release, FT Says
item.description: The Group of Seven finance ministers are set to discuss a possible joint release of oil reserves on Monday, the Financial Times reported, as the Middle East war chokes flows from the region and sends prices soaring.

item.title: Southeast Asia Faces Sweltering Heat as War Limits Energy Supply
item.description: Southeast Asia is set to see a warmer-than-usual early summer, potentially raising power demand for fuel and straining grids at a time when the Middle East conflict has tightened energy supplies in the region.

item.title: Iran Signals No Letup as Khamenei’s Hardline Son Becomes Leader
item.description: Iran chose Mojtaba Khamenei, the hardline son of the assassinated Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, as its new supreme leader, a choice quickly criticized by US President Donald Trump and one which signals the Islamic Republic won’t back down in a war now raging across the Middle East and causing turmoil in energy markets.
